title: Feedback shows rated ⌘J answers and filters to thumbs down
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData, run ⌘J twice in a draft and rate one answer thumbs up and one thumbs down
Open Settings › AI › Activity and choose Feedback
Tick Thumbs down only, then click the remaining row
expected: Feedback lists both rated answers with their thumb. With Thumbs down only ticked just the thumbs-down answer stays, and its trace shows Your rating: Thumbs down.
